"An independent CarPlay receiver for Android head units. Wired and wireless connections run on the head unit, with local authentication. A standard iPhone can connect without a jailbreak, Mac, dongle or sign-in.
This preview uses an experimental accessory identity. Compatibility with every iPhone and head unit is still being tested. It is not an Apple-certified product."

Enforced system sound (STREAM_SYSTEM_ENFORCED): often not changed by the volume keys.
Speech (STREAM_TTS): some head units give spoken prompts their own volume.

You only choose your iPhone and pair it over Bluetooth. 06Link queues Wi‑Fi links from the head unit’s state: car hotspot already on with known name/password → use it; else auto hotspot if it can start; else Wi‑Fi Direct (a link that worked here before comes first). If one cannot be built on the car, the next is tried in the same attempt. Hotspot name/password are read from the system; if off it is only switched on, never renamed or switched off. Wi‑Fi is up only when the iPhone has joined this network.
